title: STEM vs non-STEM classes
description: A pie, donut or bar chart of the ratio of STEM classes (computer science, mathematics, statistics, the sciences and engineering) to non-STEM classes, counted in courses or credits, for this term's schedule, the person's completed courses, or their completed plus planned courses, with a table listing the departments in each group.

options.pie: A pie chart, when the person asks for a pie or for shares of the whole
options.donut: A donut chart with the total in the centre, when the person asks for a donut or ring chart
options.bars: Horizontal bars, when the person wants to compare exact STEM and non-STEM counts

options.schedule: Every course offered in this term's schedule
options.completed: Only the courses the person has already completed
options.mine: The person's completed courses plus the sections planned this term, their whole record so far

options.courses: Number of courses in each group
options.credits: Credit hours in each group, when the person asks about credits or workload balance

origin.request: give me a pie chart that shows the ratio of stem classes to non-stem classes
